entities.summary: Mandate of Heaven, a pivotal event in the history of China (1046 BCE–771 BCE). Part of Zhou Dynasty. Triggered by Battle of Muye — King Wu defeats the Shang and establishes the Zhou dynasty. This led to King Wu and Spring and Autumn Period.
